description: What lib/suite.mjs reads as a broken environment in a whole-suite run with the base check. A base run that fails at scale with one signature, or a runner summary that shows a package's suite ran on neither side, is environment-broken, never pre-existing. A signature's pattern is a regular expression matched per output line; its first group, when it has one, is the key that makes two matches one shared error. At scale: the most frequent signature key matches at least minOccurrences lines and at least minShare of the failures the base run names.
